notes: Century 21 brokerage using MoxiWorks platform. Successfully captures address (from h3), price (with USD currency), and status (Pending/Active/Coming Soon). The listing_text field contains all listing details in plain text format including bedrooms, bathrooms, sqft, MLS number, and description which can be parsed post-scrape. Site has 10 active listings at time of configuration. Note: detailed fields (beds, baths, sqft, MLS) are embedded in the link structure and not easily accessible via simple CSS selectors - may need JS rendering or regex parsing of listing_text for full details.
